title: PORT-BRANCH-webhooks-1: carry webhooks-1 onto main
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** branch `webhooks-1` at 76702f4baa holds work main lacks and cannot merge as is (conflicts in code: .github/workflows/deploy-site.yml, site/worker.js)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation branchsweep --carried webhooks-1
**Status:** closed

Port the change by hand onto current main (it is 2 commit(s) ahead), keeping tests green; then the sweep deletes the branch.

size: M

**Closing probe:** python3 -m foundation branchsweep --carried webhooks-1

**Evidence:** python3 -m foundation branchsweep --carried -> webhooks-1: archived at 76702f4baa (refs/archive/webhooks-1): superseded: main holds 349 of the 350 code lines it added (BRANCH-SWEEP-4)
